scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @bazariya/api" "npm run dev --workspace @bazariya/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @bazariya/api && npm run build --workspace @bazariya/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @bazariya/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @bazariya/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @bazariya/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @bazariya/api && npm run test --workspace @bazariya/web
scripts.test:phase0: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:database && npm run build
